name: Hongshan

summary.text: HongShan is the China venture capital business formerly known as Sequoia Capital China, which Sequoia Capital announced in June 2023 it would spin off as an independent firm by March 2024. On October 17, 2023 the chair and ranking member of the House Select Committee on the CCP, Mike Gallagher and Raja Krishnamoorthi, wrote to Sequoia requesting information on its investments in Chinese artificial intelligence, semiconductor and quantum computing companies and on the split, questioning whether the separation would insulate capital flows from U.S. scrutiny since HongShan would continue to raise money from U.S. institutional limited partners.

facts.claim: On October 17, 2023 Select Committee chair Mike Gallagher and ranking member Raja Krishnamoorthi sent Sequoia Capital a letter requesting information on its investments in PRC artificial intelligence, semiconductor and quantum computing companies and on the announced split of its China arm.

facts.claim: The committee's letter flagged specific holdings including the drone maker DJI and as many as 40 investments in Chinese semiconductor companies since 2020, and asked how Sequoia would respond if a portfolio company were placed on a U.S. sanctions or trade-restriction list.

facts.claim: The committee questioned whether the split could insulate some capital flows from U.S. regulatory scrutiny, noting that HongShan relied on limited partners to finance deals so that U.S. institutional investors could continue to invest in it after the separation.
